fields.name: Employment Services · Sugarhouse Job-Search Help
fields.description: Work with an adviser on resumes, job leads and interviews. Phone or video coaching is also available.
fields.address: 724 E 2100 S, Suite A, Salt Lake City, UT 84106

informationSections.programsAndServices: Individual job-search coaching, resume help, interview practice and networking. Computers and printers are available.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Everyone is welcome; Church membership is not required.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call the center to check current hours. Walk-ins are welcome; an appointment is encouraged. Request Assistance on the website also connects you with an adviser.
informationSections.access: Sugarhouse in Salt Lake City. Phone or video coaching is available if you cannot visit.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: Bring a resume or job description if you have one. You can still get help without either.

fields.name: PeopleReady · Salt Lake City Staffing
fields.description: Apply for temporary and other local work. Job availability and requirements vary.
fields.address: 1081 S 300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84115

informationSections.programsAndServices: Staffing for short-term, longer-term and permanent jobs in several industries.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Requirements depend on the job. Ask the branch what identification, skills and work authorization documents are needed.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call the Salt Lake City branch for application help or use JobStack to look for assignments.
informationSections.access: Salt Lake City branch; check the actual work site and transportation before accepting a job.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: An application does not guarantee a shift. Confirm pay, schedule, equipment needs and any costs before accepting.
